229  def authorize_peer_address(value: str | None, *, allow_private_targets: bool) -> None:
  230      """Re-check the address a connection actually landed on.
  231  
  232      The pre-flight check inspects DNS answers; this one inspects the socket.
  233      Between the two there is a window in which a name can start resolving
  234      somewhere else. A missing peer cannot be verified and is therefore always
  235      refused, including when private targets were explicitly allowed.
  236      """
  237  
  238      if value is None:
  239          raise McpTargetError(TARGET_FORBIDDEN)
  240      if allow_private_targets:
  241          return
  242      if is_forbidden_address(value):
  243          raise McpTargetError(TARGET_FORBIDDEN)

1  """Provider-neutral context admission for the Agent runtime.
    2  
    3  The policy in this module deliberately operates on already frozen model
    4  profiles and provider-neutral model contracts.  It does not know how a
    5  provider tokenizes text, how tools are implemented, or how conversation
    6  messages were produced.  Callers therefore have to provide the category and
    7  exchange-group metadata explicitly.
    8  
    9  The default estimator is an offline, language-aware approximation. It is not
   10  a provider tokenizer or a proven upper bound: an admitted request can exceed
   11  its declared window when the provider counts more tokens. The policy accepts
   12  an injected estimator so tests and future adapters can use a verified
   13  provider-specific counter without changing admission semantics.
   14  """
   15

  106  @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
  107  class ContextBudgetConfig:
  108      """Runtime context budget knobs stored in the published runtime policy."""
  109  
  110      reserved_output_tokens: int = 2_000
  111      max_retrieval_tokens: int = 5_000
  112      max_tool_result_tokens: int = 4_000
  113      # None preserves the historical shared memory+retrieval evidence pool.
  114      # Published versions created with long-term memory enabled carry this
  115      # server-owned independent cap explicitly.
  116      max_memory_tokens: int | None = None
  117  
  118      def __post_init__(self) -> None:
  119          for name in (
  120              "reserved_output_tokens",
  121              "max_retrieval_tokens",
  122              "max_tool_result_tokens",
  123          ):
  124              value = getattr(self, name)
  125              if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
  126                  raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-negative integer")
  127          if self.max_memory_tokens is not None and (
  128              isinstance(self.max_memory_tokens, bool)
  129              or not isinstance(self.max_memory_tokens, int)
  130              or self.max_memory_tokens < 0
  131          ):
  132              raise ValueError("max_memory_tokens must be a non-negative integer or None")

  135  class TokenEstimator(Protocol):
  136      """The small provider-neutral surface required by context admission."""
  137  
  138      def estimate(self, text: str) -> int:
  139          """Return a deterministic non-negative token estimate for ``text``."""
  140  
  141  
  142  @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
  143  class ApproxTokenEstimator:
  144      """Deterministic offline language-aware approx-token estimator.
  145  
  146      tokens ~= ceil(wide_chars / 1.6 + other_chars / 4): this charges
  147      approximately 0.625 units per wide/full-width character and 0.25 per
  148      other character. It is a heuristic, not a bound on any particular model.
  149  
  150      Still intentionally not an exact provider tokenizer count: no network,
  151      no tokenizer dependency, byte-for-byte reproducible. Inject a provider
  152      estimator through ``ContextBudgetPolicy(estimator=...)`` when one is
  153      ever available offline.
  154      """
  155  
  156      def estimate(self, text: str) -> int:
  157          if not isinstance(text, str):
  158              raise TypeError("TokenEstimator.estimate expects text")
  159          if not text:
  160              return 0
  161          cjk = 0
  162          for character in text:
  163              if unicodedata.east_asian_width(character) in ("W", "F"):
  164                  cjk += 1
  165          return math.ceil(cjk / 1.6 + (len(text) - cjk) / 4)
  166  
  167  
  168  # Deprecated alias: the old name described byte counting, which this no
  169  # longer does. Kept so existing imports keep working; new code should use
  170  # the honest name.
  171  Utf8ByteTokenEstimator = ApproxTokenEstimator
  172  
  173  
  174  @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
  175  class ContextMessage:
  176      """A model message with the metadata admission must not infer.
  177  
  178      ``exchange_group`` is an opaque caller-owned key.  Messages in one group
  179      are admitted or dropped together.  In particular, an assistant tool-call
  180      message and its tool observations must be put in the same group.
